basic_details.job_title: NIPGR Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: BRIC-National Institute of Plant Genome Research (NIPGR) will hold a walk-in interview on Friday, 4 December 2026, with registration from 9:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. and the interview from 10:00 a.m. onwards. The interview is for one purely temporary Project Associate-I post in the ANRF-PMECRG project on RNA-binding proteins in chickpea; the pay is as per DBT/DST norms and as sanctioned in the project.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: BRIC-National Institute of Plant Genome Research is located at Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, New Delhi. The post is in the ANRF-PMECRG project "Deciphering the role of RNA-binding proteins during nodule development under high temperature stress in chickpea". The project is under the supervision of Dr. Divya Mishra, Scientist, BRIC-NIPGR.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One Project Associate-I post is to be filled. The notice calls it a purely temporary position. Candidates should have a Master's degree or its equivalent in any branch of Life Sciences/Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Molecular Biology or any other related field, with two years' post-master's degree research experience in the relevant areas. They should also have CSIR-UGC NET/GATE and fulfil the norms/guidelines prescribed in ANRF OM No: ANRF/OM/N-01/2024 dated 14/10/2024. Candidates with exposure to plant molecular biology and basic computational and data-analysis skills will have an advantage during the selection process. The upper age limit for the post is 50 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation. The fellowship/emolument is as sanctioned in the project and as per DBT/DST norms. Reservation of posts shall be as per Govt. of India norms. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the prescribed format. Self-attested copies of the certificates of date of birth, education and experience, submitted at registration. Complete bio-data in the given format. Original degree/experience certificates and transcripts for verification.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The application form with the self-attested copies must be submitted at registration at BRIC-NIPGR between 9:30 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. on 4 December 2026. The walk-in interview is from 10:00 a.m. onwards. Any candidate reporting after 10:30 a.m. will not be entertained for the walk-in interview. Original degree and experience certificates and transcripts are checked for verification. NIPGR reserves the right to select the candidate against the post depending on the qualification and experience of the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: The position is completely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The initial appointment will be for one year or till the tenability of the project, whichever is earlier. The tenure can be curtailed based on the assessment of the candidate's performance and the discretion of the Competent Authority. The appointment may be terminated at any time by giving one month notice by either side. Applicants will have no claim, implicit or explicit, for consideration against any regular position of NIPGR.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must ascertain their eligibility before applying, as ineligible candidates will not be interviewed. Incomplete applications and those in the wrong format will be summarily rejected. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview. Canvassing in any form or bringing influence, political or otherwise, will lead to disqualification. For queries, contact the PI, Dr. Divya Mishra, Scientist, by email only: [email protected] .
